Good day evening crew,
The welfare officer recorded some notes on cooling checks before opening, and I wanted to pass it on

Please treat those notes as part of our routine standard and review them before any animal is accepted at the counter. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. Keep carrier handling calm and deliberate, confirm ventilation and secure latches, and make sure the holding area remains clean and quiet so every pet is settled without avoidable stress. If a traveler arrives with concerns, answer in a warm professional tone and guide them through the required steps with patience.

The desk should continue to work closely with the passenger coordinator when documentation, labels, or handover details need attention. If anything appears unclear, escalate it early rather than making assumptions, and record only what has been confirmed. The ground team must move carriers carefully between services, and all staff should watch for signs that a pet needs extra care during transfer. A brief check of water, comfort, and placement can prevent problems later in the journey, especially when several services are moving through the same area.

Please also keep our communication consistent at the counter and by phone. Clear explanations help travelers understand what to expect, and they reinforce confidence in Aurelia Skyways and the Companion Animal Travel Desk. A steady approach is more helpful than a hurried one, and it supports both welfare and service quality. Thank you for maintaining the standard, for sharing concerns promptly, and for helping one another when the desk is busy.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
